question: Who was the winner of the Jnanpith award in the year 2019 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akkitham Achuthan Namboothiri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Akkitham Achuthan Namboothiri **got the **Jnanpith award in 2019**.
 
• He got the award for his outstanding contribution to the field of **Malayalam literature**.
 
• He was a well-known **poet and essayist, **known for his** plain and crystal clear way of writing.**
 
• Some of his prominent works are **Irupatham Noottandinte Ithihasam, , Balidarshanam, and Nimisha Kshetram.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• He received many prestigious awards like **Padma Shri, Ezhuthachan Award, Kendra Sahitya Akademi Award, Kerala Sahitya Akademi Award for Poetry, and Odakkuzhal Award, Vallathol Award.**
 
• He was born on **18 March 1926 at Amettikkara, near the Palakkad district of Kerala.**
 
• **Jnanpith Award **is the **highest and oldest honour of India given for outstanding contribution in the field of literature**.
 
• It was first awarded in **1925.**
 
• **Assamese poet Nilamani Phookan **was conferred the **56th Jnanpith Award 2022.**
